ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows the distribution of annual precipitation along the 35° latitude line on a certain continent. The vertical axis is annual precipitation (mm), and the horizontal axis runs from about 80° on the east coast of the continent to about 120° on the west coast of the continent. Jia is located near the eastern part of the continent, with high annual precipitation, about above 1000 millimeters, belonging to an area with relatively abundant precipitation; westward to the Yi and Bing area, precipitation decreases, and near Bing it is relatively arid. Then reason: This precipitation distribution from the east coast to the west coast along the 35° latitude line conforms to the characteristics of the United States area in North America. Jia corresponds to the humid area of the southeastern United States, and the typical river flowing through Jia and undergoing comprehensive management is the Tennessee River. The main purposes of comprehensive management of the Tennessee River include flood control, power generation, navigation, irrigation, tourism, improving ecology, and promoting regional economic development, etc. Because Jia has abundant precipitation, the purposes of comprehensive management usually do not include “drought resistance.”

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：读出甲位于35°纬线附近的高降水区，降水充沛。再结合题干“该国对流经甲处的河流进行综合治理”判断该国为美国，河流对应田纳西河。调用田纳西河综合开发的常识，列出其治理目的，发现不包括“抗旱”，因此答案为抗旱。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中为某大陆沿35°纬线的年降水量分布，纵轴是年降水量（mm），横轴从大陆东岸约80°到大陆西岸约120°。甲位于大陆东部附近，年降水量高，约在1000毫米以上，属于降水较充沛区域；向西到乙、丙一带降水减少，丙附近较干旱。
再推理：这种沿35°纬线从东岸到西岸的降水分布符合北美洲美国一带的特征。甲处对应美国东南部湿润区，流经甲处并被综合治理的典型河流是田纳西河。田纳西河综合治理的主要目的包括防洪、发电、航运、灌溉、旅游、改善生态和促进区域经济发展等。由于甲处降水充沛，综合治理目的中通常不包括“抗旱”。
